title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - TDM and Headset Audio

comment.value: I2S0/TDM program audio is buffered over LVDS to the separate AUDIO-8X8 board
I2S1 uses explicit 3.3 V to 1.8 V translation before the ES8316 codec
TPA6132A2 provides 0 dB dedicated stereo headphone amplification
Kycon STX-353K7A is CTIA-mapped; its preliminary land pattern requires a coupon

Typed off-sheet CM5 audio interface for ERC
Quad LVDS Differential Line Driver, 400Mbps, TSSOP-16
High-Speed Differential Line Receiver, 110 Ω Terminated, 630Mbps, SOIC-8
Fast-mode I2C repeater used to isolate the off-board audio-control bus
Dual bidirectional I2C Bus and SMBus voltage level translator, TSSOP-8
4-Bit Dual-Supply Bus Transceiver With Configurable Voltage Translation and 3-State Outputs, TSSOP-16
Single-Bit Dual-Supply Bus Transceiver With Configurable Voltage Translation and 3-State Outputs, SOT-363
Low-power stereo audio codec; exact pinout follows Radxa CM5 IO V2.2
4-Channel ESD Protection for Super-Speed USB 3.0 Interface, USON-10
